`❝ quote` on the end-of-turn line now quotes that turn's answer, the `/desk-activity` pane keeps its timeline in view while you scroll, and desk-look passes the plugin directory's check again.

- `❝ quote` quotes the answer of the turn it sits under, or only the part you selected, if you selected text inside that answer. It used to insert whatever you last selected anywhere in the conversation, and did nothing with no selection. `/desk-quote` still quotes your selection
- `/desk-activity`: the header (turn time, Main/agent/Background bars, axis and legend) stays at the top while the Flow, agent and background rows scroll beneath it. Only the rows on screen are drawn, so the 2-second redraw during a turn draws less. A pane too short to leave 5 rows under the header scrolls as before
- The plugin directory blocked desk-look because it hooked `prompt.change`, an event its list does not have yet. That hook is gone: quotes desk-look inserts are styled as soon as they go in, and typed or pasted `>` lines are styled as before. A prompt recalled from history shows its quote lines plain until you type

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
